thread:
Maria Chen: Hey @Kevin @Olivia — FluxMeter just sent the renewal quote (contract FM-2026-Q1). They removed the 6-month prepay credit and kept per-token the same. Feb usage spiked so current invoice is much higher than forecast (see FM-INV-3321). Can procurement push for a bridge credit or blended rate?

Kevin Liu: +1. Can we get a quick usage breakdown first? If the spike is one-off we ask for a one-time credit. Also want a quick side-by-side vs QuotaFlow (their commit model might be better for us).

Olivia Park: Finance: pulled the invoice. Quick back-of-envelope: 
```
compute_hours: 1,200 @ $0.018 => $21.60
ingest_tokens: 85,000,000 @ $0.00002 => $1,700.00
overage_adjustment: -$400.00
TOTAL (approx): $1,322.00
```
There's an "overage_adjustment" line that doesn't match our meter logs — need itemized line breakdown and GL codes before we approve any credits.

Raj Patel: Engineering note — that Feb spike lines up with an A/B test where we accidentally disabled prefix caching for a cohort. I can rollback the change; looks vendor-agnostic.

Kevin Liu: Proposed negotiation asks to FluxMeter: 1) one-time bridge credit of up to $10k, 2) 20% discount on next quarter OR a blended rate for 6 months, 3) itemized invoice + proof of meter, 4) SLA credit for any sustained latency >200ms. If they refuse, we start RFP. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Olivia Park: Finance supports asking for the credit and itemization. For anything that impacts our FY spend forecast we need PO amendment and exec approval. Kevin — can you get a ballpark quote from QuotaFlow and MeterWave by EOD Friday? We'll use that in the negotiation.

Maria Chen: I'll draft an email to FluxMeter legal/sales and cc procurement + finance. Draft snippet: 
```
Subject: FM-2026-Q1 renewal — request for credit & itemization
Body: Hi Jose, thanks for the renewal. Before we sign, can you provide a detailed invoice breakdown for FM-INV-3321 and consider a one-time credit to offset the unexpected Feb usage? Also open to a blended-rate renewal for 6 months.
```
Will post the full draft here for review.

Procure-bot: Reminder: Contract FM-2026-Q1 expires in 45 days. Suggested next step: initiate renewal workflow (/start_renewal FM-2026-Q1).

Kevin Liu: @Maria please include expected spend thresholds and ask vendor for a sample TCO calc (3- and 12-month). I'll ping Jose directly this afternoon.

Olivia Park: Tagging @Sophie — need signoff path. Finance can approve pursuit of credits up to $12k; any discounts >15% need exec-level OK.

Sophie Gomez: Approved to pursue credits up to $12k. If they want a deeper discount (>15%) require a short exec summary and commit from the product owner. Keep me in the loop.

Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll post the email draft + QuotaFlow/MeterWave pricing matrix once we have quotes. Planning to start vendor outreach today.
